Maxzz Essentials fuel contamination kit for the 6.7L Power Stroke (2011–2014). Everything needed to restore a contaminated high pressure fuel system, in one box, so the job is not held up by a missing part.

When you need it

After a CP4 pump failure or water and debris in the fuel, metal particles travel through the pump, rails, lines and injectors. Replacing the full set of contaminated components is the only way to avoid a repeat failure.

Fits

  • 2011–2014 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450 with Ford 6.7L Power Stroke

Part numbers

  • Maxzz Essentials EC3Z-9B246-B

BO.0.445.010.810.fit: 2011–2019 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450 with Ford 6.7L Power Stroke
BO.0.445.010.810.title: Bosch 0445010810 High Pressure Fuel Pump for 2011–2019 Ford Super Duty 6.7L Power Stroke
BO.0.445.010.810.desc:
New Bosch high pressure fuel pump, part number 0445010810, for the 6.7L Power Stroke (2011–2019).

About CP4 failures

When a CP4 pump fails it can send metal debris through the whole high pressure system. Replacing only the pump is rarely enough: rails, lines and injectors must be inspected or replaced, and the fuel system flushed.

Before you install

  • Inspect the fuel for water or metal particles and replace both filters.
  • Check lift pump pressure. Low supply pressure shortens pump life.
  • Prime the system fully before the first start.

Fits

  • 2011–2019 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450 with Ford 6.7L Power Stroke

Part numbers

  • Bosch 0445010810 (0 445 010 810)
BO.0.445.010.810.faq:
Q: Will 0445010810 fit my 2011–2019 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450?
A: It fits 2011–2019 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450 with Ford 6.7L Power Stroke. Match the part number on your current high pressure fuel pump or send us your VIN to confirm.
Q: Is this high pressure fuel pump new or remanufactured?
A: New Bosch.
Q: Should I replace the injectors with the pump?
A: If the old pump failed and left debris in the fuel, yes: inspect or replace injectors, rails and lines and flush the system, or the new pump is at risk.

BO.0.445.117.043.title: Bosch 0445117043 Fuel Injector for 2015–2019 Ford Super Duty 6.7L Power Stroke
BO.0.445.117.043.desc:
New Bosch common rail fuel injector, part number 0445117043, for the 6.7L Power Stroke (2015–2019). Each unit ships from our Florida warehouse, checked against the OE part number before it leaves.

Signs your injectors need attention

  • Hard starting or long crank time
  • Rough idle, misfire or a knock that was not there before
  • White or black smoke, loss of power or worse fuel economy
  • Injector balance-rate or contribution codes on the scan tool

Before you install

  • Find the root cause first. Contaminated fuel or a failing pump will damage new injectors.
  • Replace sealing washers, O-rings and any one-time-use hardware.
  • Common rail injectors carry a trim code (IQA / IMA). Program it with a scan tool after installation.

Fits

  • 2015–2019 Ford Super Duty F-250 / F-350 / F-450 with Ford 6.7L Power Stroke

Part numbers

  • Bosch 0445117043 (0 445 117 043)

A: New Bosch.
Q: Do I need to program the injectors after installing?
A: Most common rail injectors have a trim code (IQA / IMA) printed on the body. Enter it with a scan tool after installation so the engine computer can balance fuel delivery.

Signs your injectors need attention

  • Hard starting or long crank time
  • Rough idle, misfire or a knock that was not there before
  • White or black smoke, loss of power or worse fuel economy
  • Injector balance-rate or contribution codes on the scan tool

Before you install

  • Find the root cause first. Contaminated fuel or a failing pump will damage new injectors.
  • Replace sealing washers, O-rings and any one-time-use hardware.
  • Common rail injectors carry a trim code (IQA / IMA). Program it with a scan tool after installation.
